# MAIXPO

> MAIXPO 2026 is Southeast Asia's premier AI marketing conference and expo, held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia on October 28-29, 2026. 50+ speakers, 50+ exhibitors, 6,500+ attendees from 10+ countries.

MAIXPO brings together marketing leaders, CMOs, AI practitioners, agency founders, and martech buyers for two days of practical keynotes, live AI tool demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and structured B2B networking. Every session is built around deployed reality: real case studies, live tools, measurable outcomes.

## Event Details

- Name: MAIXPO 2026 — AI Marketing Conference & Expo
- Date: October 28-29, 2026 (Wednesday and Thursday)
- Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (venue TBC)
- Format: In-person conference with live virtual stream
- Scale: 6,500+ attendees, 50+ speakers, 50+ exhibitors, 10+ countries represented
- Organiser: MAIXPO (maixpo.com)
- Second edition: Dubai (date TBA, GCC-focused)

## Tickets

- Standard early bird: USD 39.99 — full main stage access, exhibitor floor, standard networking
- VIP early bird: USD 99.99 — all above plus 4 workshop tracks, VIP networking lounge, speaker meet-and-greet, priority seating
- Group rates available for teams of 10 or more (email info@maixpo.com)
- Tickets: https://maixpo.com/#tickets

## Programme

MAIXPO 2026 covers the AI marketing topics driving results in Southeast Asian B2B markets:

- AI-powered demand generation and predictive lead scoring
- Multilingual AI content at scale for SEA markets
- AI-driven attribution and revenue intelligence
- Account-based marketing with intent data
- Conversational marketing and AI-native customer journeys
- AI in influencer and creator marketing
- Programmatic advertising with AI optimisation
- Building AI-native marketing teams
- Live product demonstrations from 50+ exhibitors

Session format: 30-minute presentations with 10-minute Q&A. Four parallel workshop tracks for VIP attendees. Exhibitor floor open throughout both days.

## Audience

MAIXPO 2026 is built for:
- CMOs, VP Marketing, Marketing Directors at B2B companies in Southeast Asia
- Marketing managers and practitioners building AI workflows
- Martech buyers evaluating platforms for 2026-2027 budgets
- AI product founders and GTM leads selling to marketing teams
- Agency strategists building AI capabilities for brand clients
- Entrepreneurs using AI to drive growth

No technical background required. All sessions are in English.

## Speakers and Exhibitors

50+ speakers from CMO level, AI product leads, and growth practitioners. Speaker applications open at info@maixpo.com (working professionals with real deployment experience preferred — no vendor pitches).

50+ exhibitors demonstrating live AI marketing platforms across demand generation, content, attribution, conversational marketing, and programmatic.
